input.pitchNm: positive isotropic pitch; 16–2000 nm square field
input.heightsNm: N×N finite heights in nm, 17–257 points per axis, |value|≤100,000 nm
input.validIndex: optional symmetric closed first/last indices on both axes; invalid margin discarded on import; remaining field must meet bounds

output.coordinatesNm: uniform physical coordinates, x and y identical
output.apparentHeightsNm: simulated envelope, not an experimental result
output.validIndex: inclusive usable indices for both x and y, equal margins
output.metrics: nm: peak-to-valley, mean, Sa, Sq; validPixels is a count; positive center width only for isolated synthetic ridge
exports: apparent grid as bts.topography-grid.v1 with explicit already-dilated provenance and validity margins

identity: Repeat settings on one source revision create alternative acquisitions, not cumulative sample modification. Importing an apparent grid creates an explicitly labeled second pass and trims invalid perimeter, never undilates the measured specimen.
calibration: BTS-IDEAL-XY-Z-UNITY: pitch and z in ideal SI nm, no empirical stage calibration; 1 µm = 1000 nm.
